check_LINUX: check if the current platform is Linux using the LINUX constant
check_MACOS: check if the current platform is macOS using the MACOS constant
check_WIN: check if the current platform is Windows or Cygwin using the WIN constant
check_CPYTHON: check if the current Python implementation is CPython using the CPYTHON constant
check_PYPY: check if the current Python implementation is PyPy using the PYPY constant
